title: Length after pairing circuit pairs
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let the entries of $ps$ be pairs of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables. Pairing consecutive entries by the specified operation, while retaining a final unpaired entry if present, produces a list of length $\left\lfloor\frac{|ps|+1}{2}\right\rfloor$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of pairs of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
